title: Static and Orbit Revisited
author: P. M. Lockridge
blurb: Rosalind Winterbourne, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
